# get_ton_wallet_backup_holder_dcs()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.get_ton_wallet_backup_holder_dcs`

## Signature

```python
async def get_ton_wallet_backup_holder_dcs() -> List['types.TonWalletBackupHolderDc']: ...
```

## Documentation

Get the data centers which hold the parts of the backup of the secret phrase of the TON wallet.

Use them to encrypt the parts passed to [`enable_ton_wallet_backup`](enable_ton_wallet_backup.md).

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Returns

List of [`TonWalletBackupHolderDc`](../../types/wallet/TonWalletBackupHolderDc.md): On success, the list of data centers is returned.

### Example

```python
for dc in await app.get_ton_wallet_backup_holder_dcs():
    print(dc.dc_id, dc.public_key.hex())
```
